name: Aggressive
description: You are reckless in combat, leaving yourself open to counterattack.

name: Bleeder
effect: When you take slashing or piercing damage, you take 1 point of damage per round from bleeding until you receive any magical healing or a DC 15 Heal check.

name: Disfigured
description: You have an unsightly physical deformity.

name: Feeble
description: Your muscles are weak and underdeveloped.
effect: -2 penalty on Strength checks, Strength-based skill checks, and melee attack and damage rolls.

name: Frail
effect: -2 penalty on Constitution checks and Constitution-based skill checks. You lose 1 hit point per character level.

name: Gullible
effect: -2 penalty on Sense Motive checks. Opponents get a +4 bonus to Bluff checks to feint against you in combat.

name: Inattentive
description: You are poor at noticing details.
effect: -4 penalty on Listen and Spot checks.

name: Murky-Eyed
description: Your vision is poor or distorted.
effect: When you attack a creature that has concealment, you must roll the miss chance twice and miss if either roll indicates a miss.

name: Noncombatant
description: You are not trained for combat.

name: Poor Reflexes
description: You are slow to react to danger.

name: Shaky
description: Your hands tremble when you try to aim.

name: Sickly
description: Your body is susceptible to illness and disease.
effect: -2 penalty on Constitution checks and on saving throws against disease and poison.

name: Slow
description: You move more slowly than normal.
effect: Your land speed is reduced by 10 feet (minimum 5 feet).

name: Unreactive
description: You are slow to react at the start of a fight.

name: Vulnerable
description: You have difficulty avoiding blows in combat.
